high_level_description: This image is a surreal and whimsical artwork featuring a gorilla with angelic wings holding a Shiba Inu dog. The background consists of a cloudy sky with a soft, ethereal glow, suggesting a dreamlike or heavenly setting. The gorilla is depicted with large, white, feathered wings that extend from its back, giving it an angelic appearance. The gorilla is kneeling on the clouds, cradling the Shiba Inu dog in its arms. The dog appears calm and content, sitting upright with its front paws resting on the gorilla's chest. The overall mood of the image is serene and peaceful
